title: QUARTS for Probabilistic Traffic Forecasting: Code and Reproducibility Materials
description: Permanent software and reproducibility archive for the manuscript QUARTS for Probabilistic Traffic Forecasting: A Controlled Evaluation of Quantum and Classical Residual Calibration. The release contains source code, immutable experiment configurations, analysis and figure-generation scripts, run-level manifests and metrics, completion audits, publication tables and figures, and Springer Nature manuscript sources. Raw benchmark datasets, trained checkpoints, cached tensors, and per-forecast prediction arrays are excluded; acquisition instructions, integrity hashes, and regeneration commands are provided.
